limits: merge-tree labels textual cleanliness of the pair, not semantic independence or test success.
Pairs from existing merge commits are work the owner already merged and resolved, so merge-conflict is over-represented relative to live runs; report by source and never pool silently.
plannerAgrees compares two procedures (patch application versus three-way merge); a disagreement is data about the proxy, not a reason to drop a pair.
Only commits authored by the owner are replayed; one person's history is not a population.
Records are anchored to the run date and kept 30 days; resource pseudonyms share the record's life.
